'''Strategic Command''' was a command center located in the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Strategic Command was utilized by a branch of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service|Strategic Information Service]], the Republic's primary intelligence agency, during the [[Mission to Coruscant (Desolator crisis)|crisis]] involving the stolen [[Planet Prison]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] in [[3643 BBY]].

==Description==
Strategic Command was a large room located in the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. An operational headquarters of the branch of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]]&mdash;the Republic's intelligence agency&mdash;under the command of [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Galen (SIS)|Galen]], Strategic Command was equipped with two long tables and a large [[Holocomm/Legends|holocomm]] unit at the far end of the room. Like the rest of the Senate Building, Strategic Command featured [[Color/Legends|white]]-and-tan flooring as well as burnt-orange walls decorated by auburn arches. Large Republic banners and potted [[Plant/Legends|plants]] were displayed in the room, and several databanks and [[computer terminal]]s were arrayed along the walls.<ref name="Kidnapped" />

==History==
Agent Galen's SIS branch utilized Strategic Command by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Kidnapped" /> In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> a team of criminals from the [[Migrant Merchants' Guild]] organization [[Raid on a Republic Military warehouse|stole]] the design files for the [[Planet Prison]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], and Galen's unit was assigned to investigate with the help of the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]]. Upon identifying one of the [[Thief/Legends|thieves]], a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] named [[Vistis Garn]], Galen reported the unit's findings to [[General/Legends|General]] [[Var Suthra]] of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]]. A [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]] was sent to retrieve the files from a [[Migrant Merchants' Guild warehouse|Guild warehouse]] in the [[Old Galactic Market]] region,<ref name="Stolen Secrets">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Stolen Secrets|Coruscant}}</ref> and Galen returned to Strategic Command with the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Kira Carsen]]. When the two were alerted to the [[Kidnapping of Doctor Tarnis|kidnapping]] of the Planet Prison's designer, [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Eli Tarnis]], Carsen departed Strategic Command to pursue the kidnappers, and Galen ordered the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who had been sent after the files to bring the files back to him at Strategic Command.<ref name="Kidnapped" />

[[File:Strategic_Command_high.png|thumb|right|180px|General Var Suthra speaks with Satele Shan in Strategic Command.]]
Galen handed off the files to [[Krand]], one of his analysts, who used the room's [[Computer/Legends|computers]] to decrypt the files while the Knight helped Carsen [[Skirmish in Docking Bay 84|defeat]] some of the kidnappers in the nearby [[Coruscant Spaceport]].<ref name="Kidnapped" /> Upon discovering that the files contained information on the entire [[Republic superweapon initiative]], Galen summoned General Suthra, the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Bela Kiwiiks]] and [[Orgus Din]], the Knight, and Carsen to Strategic Command to give them the bad news. Galen, Kiwiiks, and Din departed Coruscant to secure the Republic's three offworld superweapon development facilities, but Suthra and Carsen remained behind in Strategic Command to monitor the Knight as the young Jedi embarked on a [[Raid on the Black Sun headquarters|mission]] to rescue Doctor Tarnis from his kidnappers in the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal syndicate.<ref name="Rescue">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Rescue|Coruscant}}</ref>

Suthra and Carsen were using the room's communications systems to monitor the Jedi when the Knight discovered that Tarnis was, in fact, a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], and Carsen and the analysts were able to track Tarnis's transmissions to the Coruscant [[Justicar territory|territory]] of the paramilitary [[Justicars' Brigade]].<ref name="Rescue" /> After Carsen and the Knight [[Duel in the Jedi Temple ruins|defeated]] Tarnis and stopped him from using the Planet Prison against Coruscant, Suthra met with the Jedi again in Strategic Command before sending the pair on a [[Mission to Ord Mantell (Desolator crisis)|mission]] to the planet [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] to investigate the plans of Tarnis's [[Parent/Legends|father]], [[Darth Angral]].<ref name="Race">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Race to the Ruins|Coruscant}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Strategic Command first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]], as a class-restricted phase that is involved in several missions for the Jedi Knight class on the planet Coruscant.<ref name="Kidnapped" />
